images.title: Two squares to try
images.purpose: Show the two shaded areas, 3/8 and 1/16, from halves and quarters of a square.
images.composition: Two equal big squares side by side with their answers beneath, white space between.
exact_structure: Left square: a diagonal from top left to bottom right corner, and a parallel line from the middle of the left side to the middle of the bottom side; the band between them is filled reddish purple #CC79A7, the small bottom left corner triangle is white.

Right square: cut into 4 equal squares by a vertical and a horizontal middle line; in the top left small square a diamond joins the middles of its 4 sides; the top right and bottom right corner triangles of that small square are filled reddish purple #CC79A7; everything else white.
Outlines dark #2B2B2B, extra construction lines grey #6B7280.
rejection: parallel line not from the left middle to the bottom middle
diamond not joining the side middles
not exactly 2 purple triangles in the right square
images.takeaway: Split the square into halves and quarters to find each shaded part.
images.description: Two squares: one with a diagonal band worth 3/8, one with two corner triangles worth 1/16.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Find the halves and quarters inside each figure first.

image_decisions.why: The two figures show two ways to build a part from simple pieces.
